prompt: Two figures, both fully visible head to knee, the same size, in a dim stone dungeon. On the left a hooded black-robed peasant in tattered grey cloth stands in side profile facing south-east, his trembling outstretched hand pointing in condemnation at the figure on the right. On the right a kneeling soldier in dented iron armor is being dragged backward and dissolving into a swirling vortex of wine-purple and obsidian-black death energy, his body unraveling into ash and bone. The peasant is forced to choose his own man to die. The only source of light is the sickly violet glow of the death vortex. The background is a soot-stained stone wall.

A gaunt cowled tyrant in wine-purple and black robes sits rigid on an obsidian throne in side profile facing west, his skeletal gauntleted hand extended in a downward thumbs-down verdict gesture. Where he points, a small kneeling armored figure crumbles to ash and bone, unraveling into a swirl of violet death energy. A cruel decree pronounced as a death sentence. The only source of light is torches flanking the throne, casting deep crimson shadows. The background is a vast soot-stained gothic throne hall of black stone.
